\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 182-185 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:RU-R190-first-pass-words-from-chapters-182-185}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a toilet and shampoo.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item nowadays, school holidays, a birthday, a day off, on time
  \item a side street, a pavement, a road; the way, a highway, a port
  \item in front, everywhere, to there, to here, from there
  \item a reason, a goal, a result, that means, for example
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Nowadays? (\textbf{\ru{теперь}}.) School holidays? (\textbf{\ru{каникулы}}.) A birthday? (\textbf{\ru{день} \ru{рождения}}.) A day off? (\textbf{\ru{выходной}}.) On time? (\textbf{\ru{вовремя}}.) A side street? (\textbf{\ru{переулок}}.) A pavement? (\textbf{\ru{тротуар}}.) A road; the way? (\textbf{\ru{дорога}}.) A highway? (\textbf{\ru{шоссе}}.) A port? (\textbf{\ru{порт}}.) In front? (\textbf{\ru{впереди}}.) Everywhere? (\textbf{\ru{везде}}.) To there? (\textbf{\ru{туда}}.) To here? (\textbf{\ru{сюда}}.) From there? (\textbf{\ru{оттуда}}.) A reason? (\textbf{\ru{причина}}.) A goal? (\textbf{\ru{цель}}.) A result? (\textbf{\ru{результат}}.) That means? (\textbf{\ru{значит}}.) For example? (\textbf{\ru{например}}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

(\textbf{\ru{глубокий}}.) Even? (\textbf{\ru{ровный}}.) Square? (\textbf{\ru{квадратный}}.) Sharp; spicy? (\textbf{\ru{острый}}.) Useful? (\textbf{\ru{полезный}}.) Harmful? (\textbf{\ru{вредный}}.) Local? (\textbf{\ru{местный}}.) Foreign? (\textbf{\ru{иностранный}}.) Russian? (\textbf{\ru{русский}}.) A heavy curtain? (\textbf{\ru{штора}}.) A sink? (\textbf{\ru{раковина}}.) A tap?
